sentences.en: Sami performed a beautiful rendition of a Michael Jackson song.
sentences.zh: 萨米表演了一首迈克尔·杰克逊歌曲的美妙演绎。

sentences.en: The event opened with a stirring rendition of the national anthem.
sentences.zh: 活动以一首激昂的国歌演唱拉开帷幕。

sentences.en: I like this rendition more than the original version.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢这个版本，觉得比原版更好听。
